consequence.statement: The gRPC-Web middleware addition is an optional new feature with no mandatory operational changes for existing deployments.

original.statement: gRPC-Web middleware is added to Traefik in version 3.0.0, providing support for gRPC-Web protocol handling.

decision.reason: [ev-83cbbcabe1b7] lists "Add gRPC-Web middleware" under the v3.0.0 Enhancements, so it is a new addition. The evidence does not say that any existing behaviour changes, fails, is rejected or must be migrated. That supports the consequence kind none (informational) rather than a review or mandatory-work kind. The evidence never states outright that the middleware is opt-in, so I am accepting with low confidence.
